summary: Mass-Driver's microsite for MD Nichrome, a display family inspired by 1970s–80s paperback science-fiction covers. The page is one continuous computed gradient from space-black through sunset orange and magenta to cobalt, carrying a weight/oblique list, a grid of Coldtype-animated design-note videos, auto-fitting editable sci-fi book titles with stylistic-set toggles, an OpenType feature index and three weight-graded CTA lines, under a sticky scroll-spy bar.

instances.look: A full-screen gradient from black through deep navy to pale sage, like a horizon at dawn, with 'MD NICHROME' across the top (MD in Infra hairline, NICHROME in Ultra) and a small MD logo badge under it
instances.feel: Spacious, cinematic, like a paperback cover
instances.ux: A blue 'LOADING' label on black shows first (~1s), then the name rises from the bottom of the screen to the top (seen at t≈0.9–1.6s); scroll on to reach the nav
instances.learn: Pair the lightest and heaviest weights in the logotype and let a dark-to-light gradient do the scene-setting

reconstruction.layout: Section 100vh (1440×900); name SVG full width with ~100px side margins, ~96px cap height, top at y≈80; logo badge 72×32px centred at y≈320; mobile uses a separate two-line SVG

reconstruction.assets: Name SVG (desktop and mobile variants), MD logo SVG

instances.look: Sticky 50px sage bar: Overview, Design, Specimens, OpenType, Glyphs in small mono spread across, the current chapter set bold, plus dark navy 'Try ↗' and 'Buy ↗' boxes at the right

Three short mono intro paragraphs across the top (the 70s/80s paperback inspiration, the Future Fonts history, credits), then two columns of style names, 'MD Nichrome Infra … Ultra' in navy on the left and '& Infra Oblique … & Ultra Oblique' in cream on the right, over a sage-to-orange gradient
instances.learn: Pair each upright with '& … Oblique' in a second colour: the 16 styles read as 8 weights × 2 without a table
